messages:
Lena: Quick ask 1: Zenith SI wants a smoke test of the SI certification playbook + marketplace tile tomorrow. Can eng, ops, and marketing join 07:00 PT? Need to validate badge provisioning, SKU mapping, CDN purge, and the rollback comms script.
Omar: I can make 07:00. I9ll bring the SKU manifest and the marketplace ingestion checklist.
Priya: Marketing needs final partner quote and three 16:9 screenshots by 06:15 PT. We9ll keep copy embargoed until 17:00 UTC.
eng-bot: Flag located: `si_cert_publish` (default: false). API: POST /flags/si_cert_publish {"value":"true"}.
Lena: Can ops pre-provision the partner-only badge and then flip public during the smoke test? We want partners to see it pre-launch.
partner-ops: Yes. Plan: pre-provision partners-only, toggle public at T+0 during the test, then simulate ingestion failure and rollback. I9ll add a short script for the flip and purge.
Omar: Inline snippet for flip & purge: ```bash
# flip to public
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $CI_TOKEN" \
  https://deploy.internal/flags/si_cert_publish -d '{"value":"true"}'
# purge CDN
curl -X POST https://cdn.internal/purge -d '{"paths":["/marketplace/tiles/zenith-si"]}'
# rollback
curl -X POST https://deploy.internal/flags/si_cert_publish -d '{"value":"false"}'
```
Priya: Good. Add a step to timestamp assets (UTC) so we can verify embargo enforcement. Also add the partner comms template to the deck.
Lena: Ops, can you also prepare a short incident script to send to partner if publish fails? We should show them the recovery path.
partner-ops: Will prepare: 1) immediate rollback, 2) notification to partner-PM, 3) scheduled reattempt with new commit id.
eng-bot: Suggested rehearsal timeline: 07:00 intros + checklist, 07:05 demo staging, 07:12 flip & purge dry-run, 07:15 simulate ingestion failure & rollback, 07:25 postmortem + finalize playbook.
Omar: Please paste the SKU set here: ZN-EDGE-1, ZN-GPU-2, ZN-ACC-M.
Priya: Confirmed embargo 17:00 UTC. Marketing will get final copy under NDA at 08:00 PT for last sign-off.
Lena: Deck and one-pager uploaded to calendar. Keep commentary muted during the run so timing is realistic.
Omar: I9ll join 10 minutes early to validate demo environment and logs.
partner-ops: Calendar invite created: "Zenith SI cert playbook smoke test" 07:00 PT. Invites: Lena, Omar, Priya, ops, partner-PM@zenith
